arxiv-2206-02513.title: Analytical models for the pulse shape of a superconductor-ferromagnet tunnel junction thermoelectric microcalorimeter Journal: Journal of Low Temperature Physics
arxiv-2206-02513.creator: Z. Geng, I. J. Maasilta
arxiv-2206-02513.description: Abstract The superconductor-ferromagnet thermoelectric detector (SFTED) is a novel ultrasensitive radiation detector based on the giant thermoelectric effect in superconductor-ferromagnet tunnel junctions. We demonstrate analytical models and solutions in the time domain for a SFTED operated as a microcalorimeter (pulse excitation), in the linear small-signal limit.

arxiv-2302-10960.title: Simulating the LOcal Web (SLOW)
arxiv-2302-10960.creator: Klaus Dolag, Jenny G. Sorce, Sergey Pilipenko, Elena Hernández-Martínez, Milena Valentini, Stefan Gottlöber, Nabila Aghanim, Ildar Khabibullin
arxiv-2302-10960.description: Abstract Context. Several observations of the local Universe point towards the existence of very prominent structures. The presence of massive galaxy clusters and local super clusters on the one hand, but also large local voids and under-densities on the other hand.

arxiv-2303-03338.title: Optimizing L1 Cache for Embedded Systems through Grammatical Evolution
arxiv-2303-03338.creator: Josefa Díaz Álvarez, J. Manuel Colmenar, José L. Risco-Martín, Juan Lanchares, Oscar Garnica
arxiv-2303-03338.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Josefa Díaz Álvarez, J. Manuel Colmenar, José L. Risco-Martín, Juan Lanchares, Oscar Garnica. Nowadays, embedded systems are provided with cache memories that are large enough to influence in both performance and energy consumption as never occurred before in this kind of systems. In addition, the cache memory system has been identified as a component that improves those metrics by adapting its configuration according to the memory access patterns of the applications being run.

arxiv-2510-08243.title: Localization and filtration in extended affine Lie algebras Thanks: This research was in part carried out in IPM-Isfahan Branch.
arxiv-2510-08243.creator: S. Azam
arxiv-2510-08243.description: Abstract . We investigate the notions of localization and filtration in the context of extended affine Lie algebras. Our primary objective is to develop a localization theory that facilitates the construction of meaningful local substructures, particularly local affine Lie subalgebras. These subalgebras play a crucial role in understanding the global structure of extended affine Lie algebras.

pmc-10567829.creator: Ana Reis-Mendes, Mariana Ferreira, José Alberto Duarte, Margarida Duarte-Araújo, Fernando Remião, Félix Carvalho, Emília Sousa, Maria Lourdes Bastos, Vera Marisa Costa
pmc-10567829.description: Doxorubicin (DOX) is a potent chemotherapeutic agent used against several cancer types. However, due to its cardiotoxic adverse effects, the use of this drug may be also life-threatening. Although most cancer patients are elderly, they are poorly represented and evaluated in pre-clinical and clinical studies.

pmc-11493316.title: Sex and Population Variations in Nasopalatine Canal Dimensions: A CBCT-Based Systematic Review
pmc-11493316.creator: Ashraf Mohammed Alhumaidi, Abdulmajeed Okshah, Mohammed M. Al Moaleem, Manal Ali Ahmed Alsabi, Intisar Hamad A. Muharraq, Ahmad Yahya Asiri, Yahya Abdu Mohammed Wasli, Haider Hussain S. Alhijji, Mohammed Ahmed Namazi, Amjad Ismail Ibrahim Alfaqih, Haitham Yahya Abushamlah
pmc-11493316.description: The nasopalatine canal (NPC), an interosseous conduit in the anterior maxilla, plays a crucial role in various dental procedures, such as implant placement, orthodontics, and surgical interventions. Accurate anatomical characterization of the NPC is essential to avoid complications, as its morphometric variations can impact the nasopalatine nerve and vascular structures within the canal.

pmc-11494182.title: Zinc oxide nanoparticle biofortification of lentil seedlings enhances plant growth and zinc bioavailability in rats
pmc-11494182.creator: Mona Sorahinobar, Fatemeh Saadati, Sepideh Khaksar
pmc-11494182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aimed to evaluate the potential of zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) in the biofortification of lentil seedlings and subsequently improve the Zn status in rats. In the first phase of the study, the effects of various ZnO NPs concentrations (0, 10, 20, 40, 80, and 160 ppm) on the lentil growth, Zn accumulation, and other physiological parameters were investigated.

pmc-11506267.title: Cloning and Identification of Common Carp (Cyprinus carpio) PI3KC3 and Its Expression in Response to CyHV-3 Infection
pmc-11506267.creator: Xiaona Jiang, Lijing Tian, Wanying Ren, Chitao Li, Xuesong Hu, Yanlong Ge, Lei Cheng, Xiaodan Shi, Zhiying Jia
pmc-11506267.description: Phosphoinositide 3-kinases (PI3Ks) are a class of key regulatory factors in eukaryotes that can inhibit viral replication by influencing autophagy. Currently, cyprinid herpesvirus 3 (CyHV-3) poses a serious threat to common carp culture. However, PI3K has not yet been identified in common carp.

pmc-11685212.title: Adjuvant immunotherapy after neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy and esophagectomy for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a real-world study
pmc-11685212.creator: Jifeng Feng, Liang Wang, Xun Yang, Qixun Chen
pmc-11685212.description: BackgroundThe role of immunotherapy in the adjuvant setting seems promising in recent years. As per the findings of the CheckMate 577 trial, patients with esophageal cancer (EC) who had neoadjuvant chemoradiation with residual pathologic disease should be considered adjuvant immunotherapy (AIT).

pmc-12550559.title: Hungry for connection: associations between social isolation, mental health, and food insecurity in regional Australian adults
pmc-12550559.creator: Katherine Kent, Alemayehu Digssie Gebremariam, Denis Visentin, Kelly Andrews, Grace Potter, Karen Charlton
pmc-12550559.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Food insecurity is increasingly recognized as a public health issue with social and psychological dimensions. However, evidence on its association with mental health and social isolation in regional Australia remains limited. A cross-sectional online survey among adults (≥18 years) living in the Illawarra and Shoalhaven regions of Australia assessed food insecurity using the 18-item USDA Household Food Security Survey Module, categorized into ‘food secure’ (score = 0) or ‘food insecure’ (score = 1+). pmc-12565537.title: Aetiology of Vulvovaginal Candidiasis in Ecuador and In Vitro Antifungal Activity Against Candida Vaginal Isolates
pmc-12565537.creator: Celia Bowen, Cristina Marcos-Arias, Carmen Checa, María Eugenia Castellanos, Katherine Miranda-Cadena, Elena Eraso, Guillermo Quindós
pmc-12565537.description: The epidemiology of vulvovaginal candidiasis (VVC) in Ecuador remains poorly reported and outdated. We therefore conducted a 12-month prospective survey to assess the aetiology and antifungal resistance patterns among symptomatic Ecuadorian patients. VVC diagnosis was confirmed by microscopic examination and culture. Isolates were identified by biochemical and molecular methods.

pmc-12730256.title: Dysregulation of Hedonic Processing in Chronic Pain: Insights from Preclinical Data
pmc-12730256.creator: Mariana Cerqueira-Nunes, Clara Monteiro, Vasco Galhardo, Helder Cardoso-Cruz, Feng Tao
pmc-12730256.description: Chronic pain has been increasingly recognized not only as a sensory disorder but also as a condition that profoundly disrupts affective and motivational processes. Preclinical research indicates that persistent nociceptive input drives maladaptive changes in brain reward circuits, particularly within the mesocorticolimbic dopamine system.

pmc-13313889.title: Optimizing sperm sexing in Bali cattle: Effects of separation time and bull age on BSA gradient efficiency
pmc-13313889.creator: Yendraliza Yendraliza, Muhamad Rodiallah, Jaswandi Jaswandi
pmc-13313889.description: Background:Sperm sexing is an important biotechnology for increasing reproductive efficiency by aligning offspring sex with production goals. For Bali cattle (Bos javanicus), a native Indonesian breed with high genetic and cultural value, sexed semen also contributes to germplasm conservation and sustainable breeding programs.

pmc-13560588.title: The Carceral Shadow: Criminal Justice as a Determinant of Health and Challenges for Policymakers
pmc-13560588.creator: RASHAWN RAY, KEON GILBERT
pmc-13560588.description: Policy Points The criminal justice system functions as a primary social determinant of health in the United States, generating disproportionate physical, psychological, and chronic health burdens on Black communities and other marginalized groups.Policing structural barriers—including qualified immunity, police union contracts, and municipal financing of misconduct settlements—systematically shield law enforcement from accountability and divert public resources from health‐promoting investments.

pmc-13672304.creator: Jie Zhang, Chong Wang, Yingzhu Xiao, Xiaofei Chen, James D Higgins, Wanqi Liang
pmc-13672304.description: Meiotic crossovers (COs) are tightly regulated to ensure chromosome segregation while limiting aberrant recombination. Transverse filament (TF) proteins of the synaptonemal complex (SC) regulate class I crossoverts, yet how the SC coordinates homologous recombination (HR) to maintain faithful recombination remains unclear.
